price_position.reading: There is no price position to read. The calculator holds no price at the cutoff. With neither a value range nor a price, I cannot say whether the price sits below, inside or above my range, and I do not guess. The free-cash-flow yield cross-check fails for the same reason. Its numerators are on file: free cash flow to the firm of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm} and free cash flow to equity of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_equity}. The market value they would be divided by is missing. The gap between the two numerators is worth keeping in view for when a price is supplied. Free cash flow to the firm is far below simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}, because it charges the trade working-capital build of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital} and gives no credit for customer advances. Which of the two a reader trusts changes how high a yield any price would show.

most_sensitive.reading: The sensitivity grid was not computed, because it needs the missing WACC. So I cannot say how far value moves with this driver, and I do not estimate it. I name it because the company's record pins it least. Operating margin was {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_margin|pct} in fiscal 2022 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_margin|pct} in fiscal 2023. It is {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct} over the trailing four quarters, against a three-year average of {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct}. My scenarios cover that span: the bear path ends near the fiscal 2023 level, the base just above the three-year average, and the bull just below today's margin. The starting margin itself rests on estimates. {concentration.facts.16.value|pct} of the quarter's revenue was recognised over time on cost-to-complete measures, and the quarter's own contract-estimate revision was unfavourable.

No grid was computed, so no sensitivity is read here either. The record gives growth no steady anchor. My bear case starts below the trailing pace. The base starts above it and below the five-year compound rate of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}. summary_ko.value_range: 주가 자료가 없어 베타, 자기자본비용, WACC를 계산하지 못했으므로 DCF 가치 범위는 나오지 않았습니다. 무위험이자율 {cost_of_capital.risk_free_rate|pct}, 순차입금 {ratios.solvency.net_debt} 같은 나머지 입력값은 준비되어 있어, 주가만 주어지면 계산할 수 있습니다.
summary_ko.price_position: 기준일 주가가 계산기에 없으므로 주가가 가치 범위의 어디에 있는지는 읽을 수 없습니다. 잉여현금흐름 수익률도 분자(기업 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm})는 있지만 분모인 시가총액이 없어 계산되지 않았습니다.
summary_ko.market_implied_growth: 역DCF가 계산되지 않아 시장이 가정하는 성장률은 알 수 없습니다. 비교 기준이 될 과거 성장률은 최근 네 분기 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, 삼 년 연평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}, 오 년 연평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}이며, 회사는 매출 성장률 가이던스를 숫자로 내지 않았습니다.
summary_ko.most_sensitive: 민감도 표가 계산되지 않아 가치가 어떤 가정에 가장 민감한지는 말할 수 없습니다. 다만 회사의 과거 기록이 가장 덜 정해 주는 가정은 장기 영업이익률(최근 {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct}, 삼 년 평균 {earnings_versus_cash.history.operating_margin_three_year_average|pct})과 첫해 매출 성장률입니다.
summary_ko.accounting_adjustments: 회계 분석이 제안한 조정은 없었고 가치평가도 계산되지 않았으므로, 조정 때문에 가치가 움직인 크기도 없습니다. 대신 매출채권 증가와 고객 선수금(계약부채 {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities})이 재투자 가정을 과거 기록보다 높게 잡은 근거가 되었습니다.

limits: This valuation is a set of stated assumptions run through a stated formula. It states no recommendation to trade, and a different reader choosing different drivers would reach a different value.
